role: Interface for mobs with a ranged attack: attackEntityWithRangedAttack fires the mob's projectile, driven by EntityAIArrowAttack with a power factor.

members.name: attackEntityWithRangedAttack
members.note: the witch's potion throw; the skeleton's arrow twin is skeleton_attack_entity_with_ranged_attack in hostiles_skeleton.c

notes: EntityAIArrowAttack's updateTask dispatches through this interface; the native AIC_ARROW_ATTACK update case calls the per-kind function with the clamped power factor (ai.c:2509).
